FranklinWH Home Power FHP (FranklinWH Home Power) is an advanced user energy storage system with a maximum power of 5KW per unit and up to 15 parallel machines. The device supports Ethernet, wifi and 4G network conditions. It can support the operation and setting of web and app. Manage the whole life cycle of equipment through the Internet of Things technology. The product is an industry unicorn for future renewable energy development and technological innovation.
